当敌人第一次出现在你的视线中时，有时你会有种无法克制的冲动，要冲他们喊叫。

你的喊叫声也会更大。
poor constitution: Your body reacts poorly to injury; when you suffer damage, you have a chance for your attacks to become weakened for a short while. The second level of this mutation sometimes additionally causes this to slow you as well.
no potion heal: Your system is resistant to potable panaceas, reducing the effectiveness of all kinds of healing potions. The second level of this mutation completely blocks potion-based healing. (Aid from the god Gozag is unaffected.)

你的系统会抗拒饮用的灵丹妙药，削弱了各种治疗药水的效果。
这个变异达到第二级，会完全阻断药水的疗效。（哥萨戈神的援助不受影响。）
persistent drain: Your health recovers twice as slowly from being drained. (The total experience needed is doubled.)
你衰竭后，恢复正常所用的时间是原先的两倍。（所需的总经验值增加了一倍。）
contamination susceptible: You absorb twice as much mutagenic energy from being contaminated.
initially attractive: The first time you see a monster, it may be magically pulled toward you. This has a chance of waking sleeping monsters, though they will not necessarily be alerted to your position. The second level of this mutation increases the chance of this happening.
booming voice: When reading scrolls in sight of hostile monsters, your voice resounds with a truly stupendous volume.
potion fungus: Your body is covered in a fungus that metabolises beneficial potions you drink and sometimes emits spores which transmit their effects to nearby monsters - whether friend or foe.
spatial entanglement: Whenever you translocate, there is a chance that another monster is pulled along to your new location. If you translocated a short distance, this will always be some monster in sight of your previous location, but long distance teleports may pull a monster from anywhere else on the floor. The experience is mildly disorienting for the monster, and it will not be able to act immediately after being pulled this way.
meek: All of your attacks are less effective, dealing less damage and being a little less accurate. This effect worsens with each level of this mutation.
demonic guardian: When you are harmed, there is a chance that a demonic guardian will rush to aid you. The greater the damage done and the closer you are to death, the greater the odds. Each level of this mutation increases the strength of your guardians.

当你受到伤害时，可能会有恶魔守卫冲过来帮助你。受到的伤害越大，离死亡越近，
其可能性就越大。这个变异每升一级，就会增加你的守卫的力量。
powered by pain: When you are harmed, you sometimes gain power, refilling your magical reservoir or granting you temporary agility or might. Each level of this mutation increases the magnitude of this effect.

当你受伤时，有时你会获得能量，它会注入你的魔力储备，
有时你的敏捷或力量会得到暂时的提升。这个变异每升一级，其效果就会增强。
foul stench: Foes who strike you in melee sometimes cause you to emit a cloud of foul miasma, slowing and severely poisoning those caught within. This mutation also grants you immunity to miasma (from any source).

敌人的近战攻击有时会让你发出一团恶臭的瘴气，
卷入其中的怪物会变慢并受到严重毒害。
这个变异还能让你对（任何来源的）瘴气免疫。
spiny: Foes who strike you in melee have a 50% chance of being impaled on your spines, taking damage. Each level of this mutation increases the damage. This mutation also grants you immunity to constriction.

近战中，你的敌人有50%的几率被你的尖刺所刺穿，并受到伤害。
这个变异每升一级，就会增加攻击力。
augmentation: While in good health, you are more powerful, casting spells and slaying foes more effectively. Each level of this mutation increases this effect further.

在健康状况良好的情况下，你会更有能量，更有效地施展法术并杀死敌人。
这个变异每升一级，其效果都会增强。
magic shield: When you are harmed, some damage is redirected to deplete your magic reserves instead.
当你受到伤害时，一些伤害会转而消耗你的魔力储备。
magic regeneration: 你的魔力储备的恢复速度变快。
magic link: When low on magic, you restore magic in place of health.
当魔力不足时，你会恢复魔法而不是生命值。
demonic magic: When you cast spells, there's a chance that adjacent monsters will be paralysed. This effect is more powerful when casting higher-level spells, but monsters with greater willpower can resist it. Each level of this mutation allows more distant monsters to be affected. The third level of this mutation also allows you to paralyse monsters in the same way while zapping wands.

当你施放法术时，相邻的怪物可能会麻痹。在施放更高等级的法术时，
效果会更为强大，但具有更强意志力的怪物能够抵御它。这个变异每升一级，
就能影响更远的怪物。这个变异达到第三级，你在挥动魔杖时也能麻痹怪物。
icemail: You are coated in a protective layer of ice. Fiery attacks can temporarily melt the ice, removing the protection until the ice reforms. Each level of this mutation increases the protection imparted.

你身上覆盖着一层起保护作用的冰。火焰攻击能暂时融化冰层，
在冰层重新形成之前会消除保护。这个变异每升一级，就会提升获得的保护。
condensation shield: A shield of frost guards you, blocking some incoming attacks. Fiery attacks can temporarily melt the shield.
一个冰霜盾守护着你，阻挡着一些来袭的攻击。火焰攻击能暂时融化此盾。
powered by death: Death fuels you, allowing you to heal somewhat for each life you take. Each level of this mutation increases the healing further.

死亡滋养着你，你每夺取一条生命，就能得到一定程度的治疗。
这个变异每升一级，治疗效果就会增强。
sturdy frame: Your movements are less encumbered by armour, mitigating penalties to spell success, evasion, and ranged weapon attack speed. Each level of this mutation reduces armour ER by 2.

你的行动将少受到护甲的阻碍，
并减少了护甲对施法的成功率、命中率和远程武器的攻击速度的负面影响。
这个变异每升一级，就会减少2点护甲的妨碍等级。
sanguine armour: When seriously injured, your blood congeals around you, forming armour. Each level of this mutation increases the AC provided.
当受重伤时，你的血液会在你周围凝结，形成护甲。这个变异每升一级就会提升防护。
big brain: What's up? You have a big brain. Each level of this mutation provides +2 Intelligence. The third level of this mutation also makes you less likely to miscast spells.

出什么事了？你有一个大脑袋。这个变异每升一级会加2点智力。
这个变异达到第三级，你在施法时就更不容易失误。
ignite blood: Whenever you see blood spilled (yours or others'), it may ignite, bursting into a cloud of flame. Each level of this mutation makes this more likely. This mutation also grants you immunity to clouds of flame.

每当你看到（你的或他人的）飞溅的血液，它可能会燃烧，爆发成火焰云。
这个变异每升一级，这种可能性就越大。这个变异还能让你免疫火焰云。
corrupting presence: When you injure a foe, your presence may intensify the damage, corroding their weapons and defences. The second level of this mutation makes matters even worse, adding a chance that your wretched victims may become mutated and deformed.

当你伤害到敌人时，攻击力可能会增强，并能腐蚀他们的武器和防具。
这个变异达到第二级，事态会更为严重，你那可怜的受害者将有可能被变异、变形。
black mark: When you strike a foe in melee, the black mark on your body may debilitate them. This can weaken foes, drain their health, or disrupt their magic.

当你近战攻击敌人时，你身上的黑色标记可能会削弱敌人。
它能够虚弱敌人、汲取他们的生命力，或扰乱他们的魔法。
aura of silence: You are surrounded by an aura of silence. Those adjacent to you cannot make any sound. This prevents most forms of spellcasting and prayer, though demonic magic, being noiseless, is unaffected.

你被沉默力场所围绕。与你相邻的怪物无法发出任何声音。
它可以阻止大多数形式的施法和祈祷，但恶魔的魔法是无声的，不受此影响。
bedevilling: You cast Hex spells with increased power.
你施放的妖术威力增强。
demonic willpower: Your willpower has a will of its own, sometimes injuring those who attempt to hex you. This mutation also bolsters your willpower.

你的意志力有了自己的意图，有时它会伤害那些试图给你下咒的人。
这个变异还会增强你的意志力。
hurl damnation: You can hurl damnation with %key%. Foes beware!
你可以通过<input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input>发动天遣。敌人们可要当心了！
word of chaos: You can speak a Word of Chaos with %key%.
freezing cloud immunity: You are immune to freezing clouds.
flame cloud immunity: You are immune to clouds of flame.
spit poison: You can spit poison with %key%. The second level of this mutation intensifies the poison from a single glob into a large cloud.

你可以通过<input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input>喷吐毒液。
这个变异达到第二级，毒素会从一小团毒液，变成一大片毒云。
in touch with death: Your Necromancy spells are more powerful. The second level of this mutation enhances your Necromancy spellpower further.
你的死灵法术变得更为强大。这个变异达到第二级，就会增强你的死灵术的法力。
acrobatic: Your magical nature helps you tumble your hollow bones around acrobatically, allowing you to evade attacks while moving or waiting.
你那神奇的天性有助于你杂技般地翻滚你的空心骨头，从而能在移动或等待时躲避攻击。
evasive flight: You fly evasively through the air, increasing your evasion somewhat.
你地在空中扑闪，闪避能力得到一定提升。
big wings: You have big, strong wings, capable of bearing you through the air.
你长出巨大、强壮的翅膀，它能够承载你在空中飞行。
float: You hover through the air, forever free from the surly bonds of earth.
你在空中悬浮，永远摆脱了大地的束缚。
innate caster: You cannot learn spells from books. Instead, as you gain experience, spells of higher and higher level bubble up from your fiery heart. These spells are unpredictable and unaffected by your choice of god. You cannot train specific spell schools - you can either train all spell schools at once, or none.

你无法从书本习得法术。取而代之的是，随着你经验的增加，
越来越高级的法术从你炽热的内心中涌现。
这些法术是不可预知的，且不受你皈依的神影响。
你无法训练特定的法术流派——要么同时都进行训练，要么一个都不进行训练。
hp casting: You have no separate reserve of magical power, and anything that would affect MP has no effect on you. When casting spells, using abilities, or doing anything else that *costs* MP for normal species, you spend HP instead.

你没有独立的魔力储备，任何会影响魔力的都将对你失效。
当施展法术、使用能力或做任何对其他物种来说需要花费魔力的事时，
你将转而消耗生命值。
extra vitality: You are built differently from most species, making you slightly harder to kill. Each level of this mutation increases your maximum health by 4 points.

你的身体结构与大多数物种不同，这让你略难被杀死。
这个变异每升一级，你的生命值上限就会增加4点。
frog-like legs: Your uniquely muscular legs allow you to hop short distances in the blink of an eye with %key%, though your walking speed is below average. The second level of this mutation allows you to hop farther.
forlorn: You cannot, will not, and will never worship any god.
你不能、不会、也永远无法皈依任何神。
nightstalker: You are attuned to the shadows, reducing the distance that you can see or be seen from.
你适应了阴影，减小了你能看到和被看到的距离。
+los: The darkness flees at your approach, allowing an extended range of vision and ranged attack (+1 line of sight), but also allowing you to be seen and potentially targeted from further away.

在你的道路上黑暗会遁形，从而扩大了视野和远程攻击范围（+1视线），
但也使得你能从更远的地方被发现并成为潜在目标。
stone body: You are made of living stone which is very resistant to damage. You gain a large bonus to your AC, which increases with your experience level, and are immune to petrification, poison, disease, sleep, and certain other effects.
cold-blooded: When struck by a cold attack, you may be slowed until your blood warms again.
当受到寒冷攻击时，你可能会变慢，直到你的血液再次变暖。
stealthy paws: When launching attacks on unaware or incapacitated enemies, you inflict extra damage in the same way as a human with a short blade might.

当你攻击没有意识或失去行动能力的敌人时，你会造成额外的伤害，
就像人类使用短刀一样。
four strong arms: You have two pairs of two arms, allowing you to wield two-handed weapons with one pair and a shield with the other, as well as wear a second pair of gloves. You can even wield extremely large weapons like giant clubs, though this takes both arm-pairs.

你有两对双臂，可以一对手持双手武器，另一对手持盾牌。
你甚至可以挥舞极其巨大的武器，比如大棒，不过这需要两对手臂的配合。
每对手臂的副臂的形状都很奇怪，因此你无法戴上额外的手套或魔法戒指。
retaliatory headbutt: When a foe misses you in melee, you may reflexively retaliate, attempting to gore your attacker with your horns. You can perform this against a given enemy no more than once per player action.
当敌人未在近战中击中你时，你可能会本能地进行报复，试图用你的角顶伤攻击者。
multi-lived: Every third experience level, you gain an extra life. If you are slain while you still have a life remaining, you will reappear elsewhere on the current floor. You can continue to gain extra lives even once you reach the maximum experience level, but you can't have more than two extra lives at a time.

每过三级，你将获得额外的生命。
如果你被杀的时候还有一条命，你会在当前楼层的其他地方重新出现。
即使你达到了最高的经验等级，你也可以继续获得额外的生命，
但最多只能有两条额外生命。
distributed training: Whenever you gain experience, it is split between all of your skills. You cannot choose to focus. Effects that prevent you from training certain skills, such as divine restrictions, do not cause your other skills to rise faster.

无论你何时获得经验，它都会分配到你的所有技能之中。
你无法选择技能进行着重训练。
此效果让你无法训练特定技能，仿佛是神的限制，不会让你的其他技能提升得更快。
nimble swimmer: You can blend into the waves while swimming through water or flying above it, gaining Stealth+. The second level of this mutation also grants you improved evasion and increases your movement speed when in or above water.

你在水中游泳或在水面上飞行时能融入波浪，潜行获得加成。
这个变异达到第二级，还会提升你在水中或水上的闪避能力和移动速度。
divine attributes: Your divine heritage dramatically boosts your attribute gain (Strength, Intelligence, and Dexterity) as you level up relative to other species, both in quantity and in how much you can control your development. Every three levels, you choose an attribute to increase by four points.

当你与其他物种相比，无论是在数值还是在发育程度的掌控上，
神圣属性都显著提升了你的属性增益（力量、智力和敏捷）。
每过三级，你可以选一个属性，提升四点。
tentacles: Your gelatinous body has eight tentacles that help you move around in shallow or deep water and can be used to constrict enemies while attacking them in melee. Each tentacle can wear a ring, but you need four of them to move around, and either two or four tentacles to hold a weapon depending on its size, and two tentacles to hold a shield. Your tentacles will try to constrict foes which you attack in melee. (You cannot constrict monsters larger than you.) Independently, you have a two-thirds chance of launching a damaging 'squeeze' attack whenever you attack in melee.

你的胶状身体有八个触手，可以帮助你在浅水或深水中移动，并能在近战时束缚敌人。
每只触手都可以戴上戒指，但你需要四只触手用来移动，根据武器的大小，
两只或四只触手可以拿一把武器，两只触手可以拿一面盾牌。

当你近战时，你的触手会尝试束缚敌人。（你无法束缚比你大的怪物。）
顺便一提，每当你近战攻击时，你有三分之二的机会发动破坏性的“挤压”攻击。
mertail: Your morphogenic matrix is unstable, allowing your lower body to shift to a powerful aquatic tail when in shallow or deep water. It will quickly reform into legs once you leave the water. When in merform, your tail allows you to tail-slap foes when launching melee attacks.

你的基体形态不稳定，当你在浅水或深水中，
你的下半身会变成强有力的水生生物的尾巴。一旦你离开水面，它会很快变成腿。
处于人鱼形态时，你的尾巴在近战时能够扫打敌人。
no regeneration: You do not regenerate health while resting, and are unable to receive the effects of magic that hastens the speed of regeneration. Sources of HP gain such as potions and religious invocations will still heal you, and certain divine invocations can temporarily grant you the ability to regenerate. To compensate, you are able to heal yourself via the %key% key, at the cost of permanent MP.

你在休息时无法恢复健康，也无法获得提升恢复速度的魔法效果。
至于提升生命力的手段，像药水和虔诚的祈祷仍能治疗你，
某些神圣祈祷能力可以短暂赋予你自愈的能力。
作为补偿，你可以通过<input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input> 键治疗自己，
但代价是要永久地失去一些魔力。
treasure sense: You have an uncanny knack for knowing where items can be found. As you explore the dungeon, nearby item locations that you cannot directly see will gain a marker for as-yet-undiscovered items.
gelatinous body: Your body is rubbery, and your foes like glue. Each level of this mutation confers +1 AC and +1 EV.
你的身体富有弹性，你的敌人就像胶水。这个变异每升一级会加1点防护和1点闪避。
eyeballs: Golden eyeballs sprout from your flesh like mushrooms, confusing your foes. Each level of this mutation improves your accuracy with weapons, unarmed attacks, auxiliary attacks, and spells. The third level of this mutation also allows you to see invisible foes.

金色的眼球像蘑菇一样从你的肉里长出来，能够混乱你的敌人。
这个变异每升一级，就能提升你的武器、徒手攻击、辅助攻击和法术的命中率。
这个变异达到第三级，你将能够看到隐形的敌人。
translucent skin: Your skin is transparent, improving your stealth and reducing the accuracy of your foes' attacks against you. Each level of this mutation reduces your foes' accuracy further.

你的皮肤是透明的，你的潜行能力得到提升，敌人攻击你的命中率会降低。
这个变异每升一级，就会削弱你的敌人的命中率。
slime shroud: When struck in melee, the slimy shroud covering your body may deflect the attack. Such deflection will break the shroud, however, and it will take time for it to reconstitute itself.
tendrils: When struck in melee, the slimy tendrils covering your body may grab your attacker's weapon and yank it from their grasp, disarming them.

受到近战伤害时，覆盖在你身体上的黏稠卷须可能会抓住攻击者的武器，
并从他手上将其拽出，解除他们的武装。
jelly sensing items: You have a small jelly attached to you that senses nearby items.
你身上附有一个小胶冻，它可以感知周围物品。
jelly absorbing missiles: When struck by a missile (such as an arrow or crossbow bolt), a jelly on your body may eat it, healing you somewhat.
当你被飞弹击中时（比如箭或弩箭），你身上的胶冻可能会吞掉它，并进行一定治疗。
ooze flood: Your melee attacks may flood the airways of your foes with ooze. Those that need to breathe air will be silenced and take asphyxiation damage over time.
otherworldly: You are foreign to this world, easily perceived by dark forces. You have only one-tenth the normal time on each dungeon floor before Zot finds you and permanently reduces your health.

你与这个世界格格不入，很容易被黑暗势力察觉。
在佐特找到你并永久降低你的生命值之前，你在每层地牢的时间只有正常时间的十分之一。
foul shadow: Your body is shadowed by foul flame. Foes hit you less often, and your stealth is greatly enhanced. Foes who strike you in melee are sometimes seared by the foul flame; undead and demonic foes take less damage from it, while holy beings and good god worshippers take more.
explore regen: You are invigorated by the discovery of the unknown. As you explore the dungeon, your wounds will heal and your magic will replenish.
探索未知会让你精神振奋。当你探索地牢时，你的伤口会愈合，你的魔力会恢复。
faith: You were embalmed with holy oils and sacred spices and bound about with blessed cloth. Now you have a special connection with the divine, allowing you to gain favour with your chosen god more quickly.

你被熏了圣油和圣香料，被蒙福的布裹着。
现在你与神有一种特殊的联系，你会更快被你皈依的神所赏识。
devour on kill: When you kill living creatures you have a chance to devour their life force and restore health.
当你杀死生物时，你有机会吞噬它们的生命力并恢复健康。
rollpage: You instinctively roll as you move toward enemies, rampaging forward an additional space. This mutation grants magic regeneration when rolling; the second level of this mutation regenerates both magic and health.

当你移向敌人时会本能地翻滚，会向前再冲出一格。
这个变异能在你滚动时提升魔力恢复速度；
这个变异达到第二级，魔力和生命值的恢复速度会同时提升。
double potion healing: Whenever a potion restores your health or magic, it restores twice as much.
每当药水恢复你的生命值或魔力时，其恢复量是原先的两倍。
drunken brawling: Whenever you drink a potion that restores health or magic, you perform an immediate attack against all enemies adjacent to you. (This includes potions of curing, heal wounds, magic, and ambrosia.)

当你喝下恢复健康或魔力的药水时，你会立即攻击附近的所有敌人。

（这包括治疗、愈伤、魔力和琼浆药水。）
artefact enchanting: You can use scrolls of enchant weapon and armour upon random artefacts. This cannot raise their enchantment above what would normally be possible on a mundane item of the same type, and cannot affect especially unusual artefacts at all.
runic magic: You cast spells with the assistance of glyphs marked upon your armour, greatly reducing the complex movements which would otherwise be required. (The encumbrance rating of all armour you wear is reduced by 1/2 for purposes of spell success.)
off-hand wielding: You can wield a one-handed weapon in your off-hand, if not wielding a two-handed weapon or wearing a shield or orb. You will follow up attacks from your primary weapon with your off-hand weapon, with attack delay determined by the average of the two. Ranged weapons can only follow attacks by ranged weapons, and likewise melee weapons.
slow wielding: You must recalibrate your grasping arms when wielding or unwielding weapons. This takes as long as donning armour.
warmup strikes: Your grasping arms need time to limber up, making your first few attacks in each fight less effective. Slow, heavy attacks help more than fast attacks. Both weapon-based and unarmed attacks are affected.
no rings: Your hands are embedded into the controls for your grasping arms, leaving you with no place to wear magical rings without disastrous magical interference.
iron-fused scales: Your scales are fused with a thick layer of iron, giving them resilience akin to a suit of armour (+5 AC).
inviolate magic: Your magic is resistant to distruption by outside forces. Hostile effects which drain your MP drain only 1/3 as much and you are immune to having your magical effects be removed by anyone but yourself.
formless: You have no physical body and instead interact with the world through haunting objects. This allows you to 'equip' up to 6 boots, gloves, cloaks, or helmets in any combination, but body armour is too large for you to usefully manipulate in this fashion. At higher levels, you can even send the armour you are haunting out to attack enemies independently for short periods of time.

At your current experience level, you can hold enough memories to cast a maximum of %value% spells in a row this way.

accursed: Your accursed nature makes it harder to dispel malignant energies from your being, reducing the rate at which you can recover from Doom and Banes.

bloodcurse: When you kill a living monster with a stab attack, they may rise again to serve you as a vampiric thrall. Thralls possess all the abilities they had in life, but are undead, and gain a vampiric bite attack as well as increased melee damage against sleeping foes. Spellcaster thralls will also gain knowledge of the Vampiric Draining spell. You can only create a thrall if you do not have one already, and they will inevitably turn to dust after a short time.
insubstantial: You are insubstantial and immune to many effects that require a solid body. You cannot be constricted, petrified, skewered by barbs, covered in sticky flame, or caught by webs, nets, or bolas.
frigid aura: Your breath radiates an intense chill which freezes nearby walls solid as you fight. Whenever you attack, you turn a random wall adjacent to your target or yourself frigid. Frigid walls deal damage to any enemies adjacent to them each turn - up to twice as much when an enemy is adjacent to as many as possible. This damage increases with your shapeshifting skill. The walls will rapidly melt again if you stop attacking.
hive swarm: Whenever an injury reduces your health to less than 50%, angry bees will swarm out of your body to defend you. This effect cannot happen again until your health is fully recovered.
water reaching: Your body is formed of elemental water that changes shape flexibly, allowing you to reach and perform melee attacks from several tiles away - including auxiliary attacks of all sorts. The precision required to preform stab attacks is still impossible unless you're adjacent to your target, and axes can only cleave to enemies adjacent to you, regardless of where you strike.
water splatter: When injured, parts of your watery body may splatter as puddles of shallow water nearby. The more damage you take at once, the more water is spread around.
freeze response: Whenever you are exposed to cold damage, you have a chance to become Frozen, lowering your movement speed for a short while.
steam response: Whenever you take fire damage from a projectile, you have a chance (increasing with the damage suffered) to spread steam clouds around yourself.
airstrike attack: Whenever you strike an enemy in melee, the wind twists around and strikes them for additional damage which is increased for each empty space adjacent to them.
hex mastery: Your Hexes spells are much easier to cast (reduced miscast chance and severity) and enemies have reduced willpower against all your effects.
riddle compulsion: You compulsively pose riddles to enemies when you encounter them. Every now and again, these may confuse or vex them, but mostly they just attract their attention.
werefury: Whenever you kill an enemy with a melee attack, you gain a temporary slaying bonus that increases with your Shapeshifting skill. This bonus stacks up to +12 and will not expire so long as you continue to perform melee attacks.
werehowl: When you kill an enemy in melee, if your werefury bonus is at least 5, you may unleash a terrifying howl that attempts to freeze all nearby enemies in place with fear if it overcomes their willpower.
stinger hair: Your hair is made of long prehensile jellyfish-like tendrils. Whenever you attack in melee, they will lash out and attempt to poison several visible enemies within 2 tiles of the player at random. The number of enemies they can afflict at once is improved by Shapeshifting skill.
lithotoxin: When your health drops to 60% of your max HP or less, your tendrils reflexively attempt to petrify all poisoned enemies within 3 tiles of you. This effect cannot activate again until you fully heal and its success chance improves with your Shapeshifting skill.
contaminating: When you strike an enemy in melee, a portion of the transmutational energy surging through will contaminate them. Upon landing the third strike in a row, this contamination will grow so acute that it will twist their bodily form, inflicting significant AC-ignoring damage and malmutating them.
maw attack: Your maw sometimes bites enemies in melee, at a rate independant of your own attack speed (once per 15 aut, on average). Its base damage is directly increased by 3/4rd of your strength.
devouring maw: When you kill an edible enemy in melee (anything which drops a corpse), your maw devours it, greatly increasing your regeneration for a short while. More powerful enemies provide a longer duration of this effect.
growling stomach: Your maw's appetite is insatiable. Whenever you first encounter an edible monster, there is a chance to become mesmerised by it and let out a loud growl.
eel punch: Your melee hits have a 50% chance of discharging an arc of electricity that travels between several connected enemies.
eeljolt: When your health drops to 40% of your max HP, your eels violently discharge electricity, striking all connected targets within 2 tiles of yourself - be they friend or foe - for twice the damage their electricity normally does. This effect cannot activate again until you fully heal.
blade parry: You briefly gain SH equal to your slaying whenever you perform a melee attack (with an additional flat bonus based on your Shapeshifting skill).
sporulate: Your melee attacks cause multiple burstshrooms to begin growing on unoccupied tiles behind your target. If they are allowed to grow for several turns, they will explode in a burst of spores that damages nearby enemies and can briefly daze them.
armoured shell: Your body armour is fused into your shell, multiplying its base AC by a factor that increases with your Shapeshifting skill. The effectiveness of its ego and most artefact properties will also be doubled, though certain rare artefacts may be too unusual to enhance this way.
hypnotic gaze: Your gaze has a hypnotic effect on many creatures. Whenever a living, demonic, or holy monster first notices you, it may become momentarily dazed, preventing it from shouting. Creatures which fail a Willpower check will be dazed for even longer.
gehenna destruction: Your Unleash Destruction ability is empowered by Gehenna. You are able to hurl bolts of magma instead of cold, and your bolts of fire can strip away their victims' fire resistance.
cocytus destruction: Your Unleash Destruction ability is empowered by Cocytus. You are able to hurl bolts of ice instead of fire, and your bolts of cold freeze victims solid, slowing their movement.
tartarus destruction: Your Unleash Destruction ability is empowered by Tartarus. You are able to hurl bolts of devastation which lower their victims' willpower instead of lightning, and your bolts of negative energy are more powerful.
dis destruction: Your Unleash Destruction ability is empowered by Dis. You are able to hurl bolts of corrosive acid and metal splinters instead of negative energy.

mark of carnage: Your Infernal Servants are now summoned adjacent to a random enemy instead of near you. When they appear, they do so in a blast of your characteristic Destruction (which cannot hurt you or other allies). (Your servants unleash blasts of either %value%.)
mark of the legion: Your Infernal Servant ability is replaced with Infernal Legion, allowing you to call in a small army of demons over time. While individually short-lived, their numbers are inexhaustible for as long as the status lasts, and they will never be hostile to you. mark of annihilation: Your Infernal Servant ability is replaced with Globe of Annihilation, allowing you to hurl slow-moving spheres of intense destructive force that detonate in an enormous blast of your characteristic Destruction. (Your globes of annihilation unleash either %value%.)
mark of haemoclasm: When you kill enemies, they have a small chance to explode in a violent rain of gore, which damages adjacent foes proportional to the victim's maximum health. Enemies who die to this explosion will always explode themselves.
mark of the celebrant: Whenever you fall below 50% of your maximum HP, you perform an infernal rite, unleashing a flurry of blood arrows aimed at nearby enemies. You will fire at least one arrow for every valid target, but may fire additional ones if few are present. Invocations increases the damage of these arrows, and Makhleb will always bestow healing upon you for enemies killed by them. After performing a blood rite, you cannot perform another until your HP has fully recovered.
mark of execution: A demonic incarnation of murder lies dormant within your soul. Whenever you kill an enemy in melee, there is a small chance for it to awaken and manifest as a maelstrom of scythe-like blades enveloping you. These blades will attack whenever you do and also retaliate whenever you successfully dodge an enemy attack. You have the ability to rampage swiftly towards enemies while possessed, but if you spend more than a short while doing anything other than attacking, the demonic presence will go dormant inside you once again.
mark of atrocity: Your Unleash Destruction is empowered the more times you use it consecutively without pause, increasing in both damage and health cost. mark of the fanatic: Grants you the Vessel of Slaughter ability, allowing you to transform into a powerful demonic avatar with greatly boosted offence and defence for a short period of time, in exchange for being dragged down into the Crucible of Flesh afterward and made to fight for your freedom.

renounce scrolls: You refuse to read scrolls in combat unless badly injured. While enemies are in your line of sight (and for several turns afterward), you will be unable to read anything unless your HP is below 50% of its maximum.
